schema_version: 1
name: test
requires_approval: false
steps:
  - ./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh
  - test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"
  - XDG_CACHE_HOME=$PWD/.cache GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build GOMODCACHE=$PWD/.cache/gomod go vet ./...
  - XDG_CACHE_HOME=$PWD/.cache GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build GOMODCACHE=$PWD/.cache/gomod go test ./... -count=1
  - XDG_CACHE_HOME=$PWD/.cache GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build GOMODCACHE=$PWD/.cache/gomod go build -o $PWD/.cache/bin/ms-go-statistic ./cmd/ms-go-statistic
  - XDG_CACHE_HOME=$PWD/.cache GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build GOMODCACHE=$PWD/.cache/gomod go build -o $PWD/.cache/bin/ms-go-statistic-migrate ./cmd/migrate
